articles.title: Brittany Mahomes’ women's sports vision pays off as Patrick Mahomes’ Kansas City Current investment soars to $325 million
articles.summary: The Kansas City Current are now worth $325 million, according to Forbes' 2026 NWSL valuations, and Brittany Mahomes helped build that number.
articles.body: The Kansas City Current are now worth $325 million, according to Forbes' 2026 NWSL valuations, and Brittany Mahomes helped build that number. The club ranks second in the league, behind only Angel City FC at $340 million. Kansas City's value rose from $275 million a year earlier, a jump of $50 million, or about 18 percent. Patrick Mahomes joined his wife as a co-owner in 2023, but the idea began with her. She was among the founding owners in 2020, when the team had no history, no stadium and no wins to point to.Brittany Mahomes' women's sports vision is paying off for the CurrentBrittany Mahomes played forward at the University of Texas at Tyler from 2013 to 2016 and later played professionally in Iceland. She retired from the game in 2017 and moved to Kansas City to be with Patrick. Three years later, she became a founding owner of a new NWSL club in her adopted city. The bet was that a town that packs Arrowhead every fall could fill a soccer stadium for women, too.It did not look smart at first. The Current finished last in the league in 2021, their opening season, and nobody was calling the owners visionaries yet.The climb since has been steep. Forbes had the club near $75 million in 2024, then at $275 million in 2025, and now at $325 million. Put another way, the club's value has more than quadrupled in two years. Revenue backs it up. The Current reported $36 million in annual revenue in last year's Forbes figures, the most of any team in the league.Patrick's part is real, though it came later. In January 2023 he became the first active NFL player to hold a stake in an NWSL club, joining Brittany and co-owners Angie and Chris Long. Brittany, though, is the one who started it. He has spent much of this year recovering from injuries, so the valuation has been a welcome piece of news away from football.Where the Current stand against the rest of the NWSLThe $15 million gap to Angel City FC is small, but the two clubs got here differently. Angel City plays in Los Angeles, with a big media market and celebrity investors. Kansas City is a smaller market and has built its case on revenue and a stadium made for the team.Twelve months, $50 million. That is a lot of value added in a year by a team that played its first game in 2021. Growth at that pace usually raises expectations for crowds, results and a stronger roster.Other NFL owners have noticed. Families like the Haslams and Arthur Blank have since moved into the league, which backs up the early call Brittany made in 2020. Their arrival suggests the league's top-end value is no longer a Los Angeles story alone.Still, a valuation is a number on a list, and the Current know it. The club's 2021 finish showed that money and results do not always move together. A $325 million team is now expected to compete for trophies, and the owners have said from the start they want to do right by the players and the city. Fans will judge that on the pitch, not in a Forbes table.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Drake Maye injury update: How long could Patriots QB be out and what his recovery timeline might look like
articles.summary: Drake Maye is unlikely to start for the Patriots after the bye, and the injury may be worse than a sprain.
articles.body: Drake Maye is unlikely to start for the Patriots after the bye, and the injury may be worse than a sprain. The quarterback hurt his right ankle on New England’s opening drive of a 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich on Sunday. He never came back. ESPN reported the team fears a fracture, and coach Mike Vrabel said Monday he doesn’t see Maye ready for the Week 12 trip to the Chargers. Maye had started 42 straight games. The diagnosis now decides how much of this season he keeps.Drake Maye injury timeline after the Lions lossDrake Maye went down on a third-and-goal sack by Aidan Hutchinson. The Lions pass rusher wrapped him up and rolled onto the back of his lower legs. Maye limped to the sideline, then to the locker room. The Patriots listed him as questionable, then ruled him out, and Tommy DeVito finished the game.The early read was a sprain.Dr. David Chao, a former Chargers team physician, watched the replay and wrote, “By video, mild right high ankle sprain.” A mild one usually costs two to four weeks. Chao also warned the bye week wouldn’t be enough. “This is likely a multi-week injury still,” he said.Then the story shifted. ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported the Patriots fear Maye fractured the ankle, which could require surgery, and sources told ESPN the injury could end his season. Maye stayed in Germany for more tests before heading home. Vrabel kept his answer short on Monday. “I wouldn’t imagine him being available coming out of the bye,” he said.Dr. Atsushi Endo, an orthopedic surgeon at Tufts Medical Center, gave WCVB a wide range for a sprain. “If Maye suffered a high ankle sprain, where the ligament between the two shin bones are injured, that could take anywhere from 2 to 6 weeks. If the injury is unstable, it could take two months or longer,” Endo said.The Patriots haven’t announced a diagnosis.What a longer absence would do to New England Patriots?A fracture changes the math. The American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons says most ankle fractures need at least six weeks just for early healing, and full bone healing generally takes 10 to 12 weeks. Surgery would stretch that further. Even so, the type and location of a break matter, so the word “fracture” alone doesn’t set a return date.Injured reserve is the other marker to watch. Chao hoped Maye could avoid it, but a stint there means at least four missed games. For a quarterback who hadn’t missed one as a pro, that is new ground.The timing is awkward. New England was 5-4 and coming off a 45-27 loss to Green Bay before Munich, and the bye gives the staff one week to regroup. Vrabel’s comments point to DeVito getting the Chargers start on Nov. 29. Maye came into Sunday with 2,282 passing yards, 18 touchdowns and 11 interceptions, so the offense built around him will have to change shape fast.The Patriots come out of the bye with a roster call hanging over them: hold Maye’s spot, or move him to injured reserve.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany reveal whether baby No. 4 will give Sterling and Bronze another brother or sister
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are expecting another boy.
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes and Brittany Mahomes are expecting another boy. The Kansas City Chiefs quarterback and his wife revealed the gender of their fourth child on November 17, a week after announcing the pregnancy. The new arrival will give their family two boys and two girls, joining Sterling, 5, Bronze, 3, and Golden, 21 months. The couple shared the news through a gender reveal video on Instagram, with all three children present. It also fulfilled Patrick's earlier wish to have another son alongside Bronze.Patrick Mahomes and Brittany are expecting another boyThe couple chose a cake reveal to share the news with family and friends. In their joint Instagram video, Patrick and Brittany each pulled a champagne glass from a cake. Blue filling inside the cake confirmed they were having a boy, while matching confetti cannons added to the celebration.Their children watched as the reveal unfolded. Patrick and Brittany embraced before turning their attention to Sterling, Bronze and Golden, showering them with hugs and kisses. The couple captioned the post "Baby #4," while Patrick added three blue heart emojis in the comments.The announcement also brought a playful comment from Patrick's earlier remarks into focus. During a press conference on November 11, the Chiefs quarterback had admitted that he was hoping for another boy. He already has Bronze at home and had joked about balancing the numbers between the boys and girls.“Obviously it’s a blessing to have another baby on the way. I’m excited for it,” Patrick said. “I’m hoping that me and Bronze can even up the score.”He also made clear that the baby's health mattered more than the gender. “But I’m just praying for a healthy baby at the end of the day,” he said.The couple had first announced the pregnancy on November 10. They posted a photograph of their three children placing their hands on Brittany's baby bump, alongside the caption, “Another blessing from God. & then there were 6.”Patrick and Brittany have spoken about how parenthood changed themThe fourth pregnancy marks another chapter for the couple, who have been together since high school and married for four years. Their family life has also shaped how both approach their responsibilities away from football and public appearances.Brittany has spoken about becoming more selective with her time since having children. In a July interview with Yahoo Entertainment, she explained how motherhood changed her priorities."When you become a mom, you learn to say no to things that aren't as important and focus on what's best for your life and your family," she said. "Keeping my eyes and my mind and my focus on my family and the things that matter the most."Patrick has also discussed the lessons fatherhood has taught him, particularly patience and the need to encourage his children. Ahead of the 2024 Super Bowl, he told reporters that building confidence was an important part of raising them."You learn how to try to really boost people’s confidence, especially your kids,” he shared, per KSL Sports. “Through seasons like I’ve had this last year, it’s never losing hope, never going too negative in adverse times. Just continue to boost people’s confidence, continue to strive for hard work and really be patient."With another son on the way, Patrick's wish has come true. The Mahomes household will soon have two boys and two girls, and Sterling, Bronze and Golden will have a new sibling to welcome.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: "I love you Boys to death. But...": Post Malone can no longer hide his frustration as Dallas Cowboys’ latest loss pushes him over the edge
articles.summary: Post Malone has seen enough. The singer posted a heated message on X after the Dallas Cowboys lost 46-40 to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday, Nov.
articles.body: Post Malone has seen enough. The singer posted a heated message on X after the Dallas Cowboys lost 46-40 to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday, Nov. 15, at AT&T Stadium. Dallas gave up a franchise-record 584 yards, even though Dak Prescott threw five touchdowns. Malone, a Cowboys fan since childhood, called the defense out of control and asked the team to fix it. He still ended the post with love for the players. It was a blunt message from one of the team’s loudest supporters, and his patience clearly has limits.Post Malone calls out Cowboys after 49ers lossMalone took to X after the game, and he skipped the polite version. He opened with the defense.“600 yards allowed is out of control. With the amount of studs we have on this team, there is no reason to keep losin EVERY [expletive] SUNDAY,” he wrote. The real figure was 584, close enough that no fan will quibble.He kept going, and he did not name a single player. “I love you Boys to death. But we gotta fix this [expletive]. Don’t give up fellas @dallascowboys,” he continued. Then came the sign-off. “p.s. if you’re readin this I love YOU too.”That mix is what makes the post work. Anger is easy. Staying loyal while you rage is harder, and it sounds like every fan who has yelled at a TV on a bad Sunday.That is the odd part of this loss. Prescott’s five touchdowns and 40 points would win most days. Instead, the defense turned a shootout into a record night for the other side.Why the Cowboys mean so much to himMalone was born Austin Richard Post in Syracuse, New York. He moved to Grapevine, Texas, at age 9 because his father, Rich Post, landed a job overseeing concessions for the Cowboys. Some days, young Austin slept on a cot at Texas Stadium while his dad worked.The 31-year-old has since become one of the most recognizable Cowboys fans anywhere. He has brought that history into his work. In 2023, he released a limited-edition Cowboys apparel collection and teamed up with Raising Cane’s on a Cowboys-themed restaurant in Dallas. When his tour stopped at AT&T Stadium in May 2025, he wore kicker Brandon Aubrey’s No. 17 jersey.The big stages followed. He sang “America the Beautiful” before Super Bowl LVIII in February 2024 and joined Beyoncé as a surprise guest at her Christmas Day halftime show that December. Then came Thanksgiving 2025, when he headlined the Cowboys’ halftime show against the Chiefs. “I’m from Texas. I grew up a Cowboys fan and have been watching this halftime show for years,” Malone said when the performance was announced. For the kid from the cot, it was a real homecoming.Nearly a year on, the view from his seat is rougher. Sunday’s game made that clear. He is still all in, but he wants a defense worth cheering for.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.body: Joe Burrow, the Cincinnati Bengals’ quarterback, might be keeping his rumored relationship with social media influencer Olivia Ponton, away from the spotlight, but he had turned heads with her during the offseason. As the star player remains committed to his team, his girlfriend Olivia Ponton has marked a new milestone.Joe Burrow’s rumored girlfriend Olivia Ponton makes a wholesome post about what she was busy doingA few hours ago, the Sports Illustrated model Olivia Ponton took to her social media to make a post that read as, “First in my bloodline to hike an active volcano🌋 Jk this is my family & I hiking a volcano when I was 4🎀 Hour 18 of our 24 hour hike🌋 my view from bed: @xandrapohl starting the initial dissent🥾”The post added, “Goodmorning Guatemala🇬🇹 Just enjoying my morning hot coco Jaw dropped 5th country together with @xandrapohl Post 24 hour hike I am in utter AWE. This is LIFECHANGING. Hike tip: take altitude sickness medication… I was down bad my oura ring says 5hours 56 mins Back where we started… FINISHED the hike🇬🇹 Outfit details Just had to add one more…”Joe Burrow’s rumored girlfriend Olivia Ponton also posted several moments from her hike on social media.One post showed her sitting down as the caption added, "ngl my head was pounding last night but after sleeping 6ish hours I've had time to acclimate…The hike itself wasn't TOO hard!! Just the thin air made it feel 10 times crazier".Another post showed her posing while hiking as she added, "that was the most insane hike of my life .. 6 hours up to 13,000ft. I am proud of myself but i definitely need to sleep for the next 3 days".Olivia Ponton marks a new milestone in her career as Joe Burrow remains busyJoe Burrow’s rumored girlfriend Olivia Ponton’s post about her life comes at a time when there have been many cheating rumors related to the star player on social media.However, none of these claims are verified as neither Joe Burrow nor the popular social media influencer Olivia Ponton has addressed these claims as they remain silent about their lives.While Joe Burrow remains focused on his performance in the new season, Olivia Ponton has continued to work on new projects as her recent podcast, Booked & Busy, has broken records.Earlier this year, in an interview with Numero, Olivia Ponton had opened up about it as she said, “I want it to keep evolving into something more immersive and culturally expansive, while still staying rooted in storytelling.”The popular social media influencer added, “Creatively, I’d love to expand beyond just the podcast into more social segments, visual storytelling, and community driven moments. The goal is for it to feel bigger than just a podcast eventually, more like a creative world people actually want to be part of.”Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Ciara has one request before welcoming baby No. 5 as Russell Wilson gets ready for another life-changing moment: ‘It’s Time’ for the Baby ‘Train to Slow Down’
articles.summary: Ciara and Russell Wilson are expecting their fifth child, and the singer says the pregnancy is going well.
articles.body: Ciara and Russell Wilson are expecting their fifth child, and the singer says the pregnancy is going well. The 41-year-old gave PEOPLE an update at Macy’s Santaland Premiere in New York City on Thursday, Nov. 12. The couple announced the news on Sept. 6, 2026, with a short social media post. Their message read “One more person to Love 🖐🏽🥺🖤.” Two months later, Ciara says she has to slow down at certain points in the day. Wilson, 37, joked about how often the family grows, and she had a quick reply ready.Ciara says it is time for the baby train to slow downShe did not sound worried. If anything, she sounded a little surprised at how easy it has been. “Sometimes I forget I have a bump on my life. I feel really blessed. I don’t have crazy pregnancies for the most part,” she tells PEOPLE.That does not mean she is going full speed. The Grammy winner said she still has to ease off as the day wears on. “So this mom is rolling. Now don’t get me wrong, at a certain point in the day, I got to slow it down,” Ciara tells PEOPLE. “I’m feeling all kinds of stuff happening, but all in all, I feel really good. I feel really blessed. I’m excited for the new little one.”She added that she cannot wait to meet the baby. She is “really happy and thankful” heading into the holiday season.Wilson, a retired NFL player and now an analyst for CBS Sports, was in a good mood too. “We always have a good time this time of year,” he says, before pointing out a pattern in the family calendar. “It’s been like every three years,” he tells PEOPLE, as Ciara responds, “Oh, stop it. I think it’s time for the train to slow down.”They have not shared the baby’s gender. The couple married in 2016 and already have three children together: Sienna Princess, 9, Win Harrison, 6, and Amora Princess, 2. Ciara is also mom to Future Zahir, 12, whom she shares with her ex-fiancé Future, whose real name is Nayvadius DeMun Cash.The kids are ready and the holidays are closeAt home, the big siblings seem to be fully on board. Ciara says the kids “are so sweet with the new little one” and keep showering her with belly kisses. “They always kiss my belly. They’re really clear on what’s happening. I think we need to say the baby is the gift,” she adds.Santaland at Macy’s Herald Square opens Nov. 27. Visitors can ride a train called the North Star Express, grab hot cocoa and stop for photos on the way to Santa.“It’s an honor to be here. We all know how iconic Macy’s is ... And I’ve, over the years, been so fortunate to participate in the Macy’s Day Parade. So many great memories here. Our kids brand, 3Brand, is actually in the Macy’s store,” she tells PEOPLE.Macy’s picked the family to host the moment. “It’s pretty cool,” she adds. The baby train may be slowing down, but the North Star Express is about to start running.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: One of the greatest comebacks: How former Kansas City Chiefs' star Eric Berry went from battling cancer to earning the NFL’s highest honors
articles.summary: Eric Berry, the former Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, might have had a lot of talent and skills but things went haywire in his life when he was
articles.body: Eric Berry, the former Kansas City Chiefs’ star player, might have had a lot of talent and skills but things went haywire in his life when he was diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma in December 2014 after a mass was discovered in his chest. At the peak of his career, Eric Berry had to leave his career but that was not the end of his story.Eric Berry fought against cancer and came back to the field to achieve a record breaking performance for the Kansas City ChiefsEric Berry took some time off as the Kansas City Chiefs stood by his side after his diagnosis in December 2014.In the next few months, Eric Berry remained aggressive with his treatment and in 2015, he bounced back on the field after he was declared cancer free by doctors.Despite fighting against cancer, Eric Berry recorded a pretty impressive performance in 2015 when he returned to the field.Eric Berry appeared in all 16 games (15 starts), recording 61 combined tackles (55 solo), 10 passes defended, and 2 interceptions for 40 return yards. He helped the Kansas City Chiefs win 10 straight regular season games to reach the playoffs.In the Wild Card round, Eric Berry recorded 3 tackles and a first-quarter interception in a 30–0 shutout win over the Houston Texans.This also led Eric Berry to win Comeback Player of the Year with 38 of 50 votes as well as a Pro Bowl selection and First-Team All-Pro honors.In an interview with reporters back then, Eric Berry had reflected on his achievements as he said, "To be honest with you, I think it will mean a lot for the people who followed my story—the people who are going through things and fighting through something like cancer…”He added, “I just wanted to show those people anything is possible and that you can't let anything come between you and your dreams. "As long as somebody sees my story and is inspired, I think that was my main goal going through everything that I went through—just being strong for people who couldn't be strong for themselves."The Kansas City Chiefs Chairman and CEO Clark Hunt also opened up on Eric Berry’s comeback as he said, "Eric is a very, very special person. And I say that even not taking into consideration the health problems he's had over the past year—overcoming cancer. He's somebody who has been a great player and a team leader. His ability and willingness to come back from the cancer treatments that he'd been through in early 2015 says so much about him as a person.”The billionaire owner added, "I think that desire and that passion for the game really had an impact on the Chiefs throughout the 2016 season. I think he was somebody they could rally around early in the year when things weren't going well. He wasn't somebody who put his head down and he really helped the team get the season turned around and make the playoffs."Eric Berry’s injury in 2017 changed his career for himIn the 2016 season, Eric Berry started all 16 games, recording 77 combined tackles, 4 interceptions, and 2 defensive touchdowns.However, in 2017, he tore his Achilles tendon which marked a turning point in his career as it ended the season for him after just one game.A year later, a painful Haglund's deformity on his heel sidelined him for nearly the entire 2018 season and he was later released by the Kansas City Chiefs in 2019.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates.
